serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Paste this into Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client to connect.

howTo.title: How to connect
howTo.description: Pick the app you use. Each takes about a minute.

claude.step1: Open Claude and go to Customize → Connectors (also reachable from Settings).
claude.step2: Choose Add → Add custom connector. Name it AgentSDR, paste the server URL above, and choose Continue.
claude.step3: Once Claude has checked the server, choose Add, then Connect.
claude.step4: Sign in to AgentSDR if asked, check the organization, and choose Allow.
claude.step5: In a chat, switch AgentSDR on from the tools menu and ask, for example, “What's in my Action required queue?”
claude.teamNote: On Claude Team and Enterprise plans, an owner must first add the connector under organization settings before members can connect it.

code.step3: Select agentsdr, choose Authenticate, and your browser opens.
code.step4: Sign in to AgentSDR if asked and choose Allow.

other.clients: Any client that supports remote MCP over Streamable HTTP with OAuth works with the same server URL, including ChatGPT (add AgentSDR as a custom app in its settings), Cursor and other editors.
other.apiKey: For a setup with no browser, an owner or admin can create an API key under Settings → API keys and send it as Authorization: Bearer asdr_…. A key acts as the whole organization, not as one person.
